name: FreeRTOS LVGL designer project
description: Create complex LVGL user interfaces for 32-bit microcontrollers, driven by a FreeRTOS task.
files_included:
**CMakeLists.txt:** Build setup.
**main.c:** Starts the scheduler.
**app/app_freertos.c/.h:** LVGL task: tick, touch and rendering.
**config/FreeRTOSConfig.h:** Kernel configuration.
**main_screen.mscr/.c:** Blank main screen and its init code.
outputs:
**.hex:** Hexadecimal binary for MCU flashing.
**.bin:** Raw binary for various deployment options.
requirements:
mikroSDK
Clock: > 64 MHz
Flash/ROM: > 200 kB
RAM: > 48 kB
FreeRTOS package.
